question: What bodily form results from constant yogic practice over time?
premises: The practice is constant yogic exercise.
A specific duration is indicated as sixteen years.
A resulting bodily form is attained.
inference: Through constant yogic practice, one may attain the form of a sixteen-year-old.
uncertainties: dvi aṣṭa varṣa ākṛtiḥ is interpreted as the form of sixteen years
plain_english: Through constant yogic practice, one may attain the form of a sixteen-year-old.
